title.zh: v2.1.10 会话状态搬出视图；「删掉一端仍能编译」变成机械门禁
title.en: v2.1.10 Session State Out of the View; “Delete a Surface and It Still Compiles” Becomes a Gate

highlights.zh: **判据是可执行的，就不该靠人读代码来相信。** 计划里那条「删掉某一端整个目录后 `src/features` 与 `src/audio` 仍应能编译通过」现在是一条门禁：`check:isolation` 把 `src`（连同 GS-1 host 相对引用的 `vendor/`）复制一份，**删掉 `components/`、`views/`、`ui/`、`App.tsx`、`test/`**，再跑 `tsc --noEmit`。7.5 秒，已进 `verify`。失败可证：往 `src/features` 放一个 `import … from "../../components/…"` 的探针，立刻报 `TS2307: Cannot find module`；删掉即绿。用真复制而不是路径改写，因为改写会让 `tsc` 用不同的解析规则，那样「隔离通过」证明不了任何事。
highlights.en: **A criterion that can be executed should not rest on someone reading the code.** The plan's rule — *delete a surface's whole directory and `src/features` plus `src/audio` still compile* — is now a gate: `check:isolation` copies `src` (plus the `vendor/` directory the GS-1 host imports by relative path), **deletes `components/`, `views/`, `ui/`, `App.tsx` and `test/`**, and runs `tsc --noEmit`. highlights.zh: **三组状态搬出 `StudioView`**，进 `features/sequencer/hooks/useStudioSession.ts`：`usePlaybackSettings({ genre })`（鼓组起始值来自曲风默认，drums-only 与录音待命**都不持久化**——静默重新待命比忘掉更糟）、`useKeyboardPerformance()`（FAB 偏好是存的，本标签页的自定义事件与跨标签页的 `storage` 两条同步路径都归它管）、`useInspectorCursor()`（重排后检查器跟着**音轨**而不是行号）。新增 11 条测试**不再需要渲染整个工作室**——这才是「下一端能复用」的实际含义。
highlights.en: **Three groups of state moved out of `StudioView`** into `features/sequencer/hooks/useStudioSession.ts`: `usePlaybackSettings({ genre })` (the kit starts at the genre's default; drums-only and record-arm are **never persisted** — silently re-arming is worse than forgetting), `useKeyboardPerformance()` (the FAB preference is stored, and both sync paths belong to it: the in-tab custom event and the cross-tab `storage` event) and `useInspectorCursor()` (after a row reorder the…

highlights.zh: **顺手收掉一个静默 bug 的温床**：FAB 偏好的事件名原本是两处字面量（写方 `dispatchEvent`、听方 `addEventListener`），打错一个字母不会有任何报错——读者只会继续显示旧值。现在是一个常量 `FAB_PREF_CHANGED_EVENT`。
highlights.en: **And one silent-bug trap closed**: the FAB preference's event name was a string literal in two places (the writer's `dispatchEvent`, the listener's `addEventListener`). A typo in one of them raises nothing — the reader simply keeps showing the old value. It is now the constant `FAB_PREF_CHANGED_EVENT`.
